locale.name: Latīnē
settings.text.1: Sonī certāminis et mūsica · interruptor omnia tacet
settings.text.6: Mōtus minor: minus animātiōnum, gemmae nōn volant.
settings.text.8: Post errōrem explicātiō manet dōnec "Perge" premis (aut spatium / Enter,skin:skin).
settings.text.10: Theātrum: sententiae Latīnae, interpretātiōnēs in linguā ēlēctā · interfaciēs Latīna manet.
settings.text.12: Lingua nōndum parāta ēligī nōn potest: nihil aliā linguā ostenditur.
settings.text.14: Ūna trānsāctiō prō ūnā respōnsiōne; perītia ante respōnsum computātur.
settings.text.24: Cōnservātiō praesēns dēlēbitur et ē tabellā restituētur.
settings.text.29: Gemmae, emptiōnēs et perītiae dēlēbuntur. Hoc revocārī nōn potest.
settings.text.32: Grammatica: Allen & Greenough, New Latin Grammar (1903,skin:skin), ēditiō Dickinson College Commentaries (CC BY-SA).
settings.text.33: Theātrum: Biblia Sacra Vulgata Clementina (textus 1598, ēditiō Migne 1880,skin:skin) et La Sainte Bible, Louis Segond 1910 — eBible.org, in pūblicō (ēditiō Desclée 1901 postulāta, digitāliter nōn exstat).
settings.text.34: Fōrmae in ipsō lūdō generantur; cum Collatinō (GPL-3.0,skin:skin) in officīnā tantum comparātae sunt.
settings.text.35: Litterae Cinzel et Nunito (OFL,skin:skin). Imāginēs et sonī hīc factī (CC0), prōvīsōriī.
settings.persistence.subtitle: Servātur post omne respōnsum et omnem emptiōnem · schēma 1.
